description: This file defines the UrlGenerator class in Drupal, responsible for generating URLs from route names and parameters, integrating with Symfony routing components and Drupal-specific path processing.

classes.name: UrlGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates URLs based on route names and parameters within Drupal, implementing Symfony's UrlGeneratorInterface.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the request context for URL generation.

methods.name: setStrictRequirements
methods.description: Stub method to set strict requirements; currently does nothing.

methods.name: isStrictRequirements
methods.description: Returns true, indicating strict URL requirements are enforced.

methods.name: getPathFromRoute
methods.description: Generates a URL path from a route name and parameters, removing query strings.

methods.name: doGenerate
methods.description: Core method that substitutes route parameters into the route path, throwing exceptions if parameters are missing or invalid.

methods.name: getInternalPathFromRoute
methods.description: Retrieves the internal URL path for a given route.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a URL, either absolute or relative, from a route name and parameters.

methods.name: generateFromRoute
methods.description: Generates a URL from a route name, parameters, and options, handling path processing, query parameters, and absolute URL construction.

methods.name: processPath
methods.description: Allows outbound path processing via a path processor.

methods.name: processRoute
methods.description: Allows outbound route processing via a route processor.

methods.name: getRoute
methods.description: Retrieves a route object by name from the route provider.
